headline: China Mandates 70% Homegrown Silicon Wafer Use to Localize Critical AI Chip Supply Chain Amid Export Restrictions
summary: This aggressive government directive significantly escalates China's pursuit of semiconductor self-sufficiency, directly challenging existing global supply chains and intensifying tech decoupling. The move aims to secure critical inputs for its burgeoning AI industry, profoundly impacting global geopolitics and the semiconductor manufacturing landscape for years to come.
